requirement_text: SessionSnapshot struct with serde serialization
target_value: Session state serializable to JSON for persistence
notes: SessionSnapshot: session_id + messages (Vec<ChatMessage>) + input_tokens + output_tokens + model_name + working_dir + timestamp. Derive Serialize/Deserialize. ChatMessage needs serde derives.

requirement_text: Save session snapshot to ~/.aegis/sessions/
target_value: Session written to disk as atomic JSON file
notes: save_session(snapshot) writes to ~/.aegis/sessions/<id>.json via atomic tmp+rename. Directory auto-created with 0700 perms. current.json symlink to latest.

requirement_text: Load session snapshot from disk
target_value: Previous session restored from JSON file
notes: load_session(path) reads JSON and returns SessionSnapshot. Validates schema version. Returns None if file missing or corrupt (never crash).

requirement_text: Modular left-pane agent selection for dev loop
target_value: Developer can specify any AI coding agent (claude/gemini-cli/codex/aegis) for the left pane
notes: AEGIS_DEV_AGENT env var or --agent flag selects left-pane agent. Default: claude. Supported: claude/gemini-cli/codex/aegis/custom. Custom: any executable name. Agent receives the critical path prompt as positional arg. Preflight validates binary exists in PATH.

requirement_text: Dev loop GIF freshness validated by pre-push hook
target_value: Pre-push hook fails if docs/demos/dev-loop.gif missing or older than dev.sh
notes: VHS tape at docs/demos/tapes/dev-loop.tape records a REAL session (not simulation). Regeneration is manual: vhs docs/demos/tapes/dev-loop.tape. Pre-push hook validates the GIF exists and is at least as new as scripts/dev.sh. Hook fails fast with regen instructions if stale.

requirement_text: Default backend selection chain on first run
target_value: aegis with no config auto-selects local Ollama or GCP plugin without manual setup
notes: Chain: (1) Probe Ollama localhost:11434 for llama3 -- if found auto-write local config; (2) Else fall through to gcp-assured-workloads plugin path; (3) Else print install guidance and exit. The only manual step is gcloud auth in the cloud path.

requirement_text: Auto-detect llama3 model in Ollama and write local config
target_value: Probe localhost:11434/v1/models for llama3 and auto-configure aegis to use it
notes: GET http://localhost:11434/v1/models. Parse JSON response. Look for model with id starting with llama3. If found: write ~/.aegis/config.yaml with mode=local endpoint=http://localhost:11434/v1 model=llama3 (or matching variant). 2-second timeout.

requirement_text: Auto-download gcp-assured-workloads plugin from GitHub release
target_value: If plugin missing aegis downloads pre-built binary from latest GitHub release
notes: Detect ~/.aegis/plugins/gcp-assured-workloads. If absent: GET https://api.github.com/repos/rtmx-ai/gcp-assured-workloads/releases/latest. Parse asset URL for current OS/arch (darwin-x86_64 darwin-arm64 linux-x86_64). Download tarball verify SHA256 extract to ~/.aegis/plugins/. chmod +x. Show progress.

requirement_text: Validate gcloud Application Default Credentials before plugin invocation
target_value: aegis verifies ADC is valid and offers to run gcloud auth login if not
notes: Run: gcloud auth application-default print-access-token. If success: continue. If failure: print 'Run: gcloud auth application-default login' and exit non-zero. No automatic browser launch (would interfere with TUI). User runs auth manually then re-runs aegis.

requirement_text: Plugin preview and confirmation before auto-provisioning
target_value: aegis shows plugin preview output and requires explicit yes before running up
notes: Run plugin preview command. Display: project_id region impact_level resource list estimated cost. Prompt: 'Proceed with provisioning? [yes/no]'. Only on exact 'yes' response: run plugin up. On no or other input: exit. Provisioning events stream to stderr. Result event captured and config written.

requirement_text: Helpful failure message when no backend available
target_value: aegis exits with install guidance if neither Ollama nor cloud auth is available
notes: If Ollama probe fails AND gcloud auth fails: print multi-line guidance: (1) Install Ollama: brew install ollama; ollama pull llama3; (2) OR authenticate cloud: gcloud auth application-default login. Exit code 78 (config error). No partial state written.

requirement_text: CycloneDX SBOM generated in CI release builds
target_value: Every release artifact has an accompanying CycloneDX SBOM JSON
notes: cargo-cyclonedx generates per-crate SBOMs at <crate>/<name>.cdx.json. CI sbom job verifies aegis-cli SBOM (282 components CycloneDX 1.5) and uploads all per-crate SBOMs as aegis-cli-sbom artifact (90-day retention). Test module path is .github/workflows/ci.yml not release.yml. No secrets required.

requirement_text: GPG signing of Linux release artifacts
target_value: Linux release binaries and packages are signed with project GPG key
notes: GPG key stored in GitHub Actions secret. Release workflow signs .tar.gz + .deb + .rpm + sbom.json. Detached .asc signatures uploaded as release assets. Consumers verify via gpg --verify.

requirement_text: Authenticode signing of Windows release artifacts
target_value: Windows binaries and MSI are Authenticode-signed
notes: Code-signing certificate stored in GitHub Actions secret. SignTool.exe signs .exe + .msi. Timestamped signature via SHA256 RFC 3161 TSA. Blocked: requires organizational cert purchase.

requirement_text: cargo-deb generates unsigned .deb package
target_value: CI produces a valid .deb package installable on Ubuntu/Debian
notes: cargo-deb crate invoked in CI deb-package job. Reads [package.metadata.deb] from crates/aegis-cli/Cargo.toml. Produces target/debian/aegis-cli_X.Y.Z-1_amd64.deb (1.6MB). Verified locally and on Ubuntu CI runner. Assets: /usr/bin/aegis + LICENSE + README.md.

requirement_text: cargo-generate-rpm generates unsigned .rpm package
target_value: CI produces a valid .rpm package installable on RHEL 8/9
notes: cargo-generate-rpm crate invoked in CI. Reads metadata from Cargo.toml [package.metadata.generate-rpm]. Produces target/generate-rpm/aegis-cli-X.Y.Z.x86_64.rpm. No signing at this stage.

requirement_text: SELinux file context labels on .rpm package
target_value: RPM installs aegis binary with correct SELinux type bin_t
notes: RPM spec includes %files section with SELinux file context: /usr/bin/aegis bin_t. Tested via rpm -qv --filecontext.

requirement_text: deb install smoke test on Ubuntu CI
target_value: CI job installs .deb and runs aegis --version
notes: Ubuntu CI deb-package job runs sudo dpkg -i + aegis --version after generating the .deb. Asserts exit 0 and version output. Combined with REQ-BUILD-042 in the same job for atomicity.

requirement_text: rpm install smoke test on RHEL CI
target_value: CI job installs .rpm and runs aegis --version
notes: RHEL 9 container in CI: rpm -i target/generate-rpm/aegis-cli-*.rpm. Run aegis --version. Assert exit 0 and version string present.

requirement_text: WiX toolchain generates unsigned .msi from Rust binary
target_value: CI produces a valid .msi installer for Windows
notes: cargo-wix crate or direct WiX v4 toolchain invocation. Reads product metadata from Cargo.toml. Produces target/wix/aegis-X.Y.Z-x86_64.msi. No signing at this stage.

requirement_text: msi silent install smoke test on Windows CI
target_value: CI job runs msiexec /qn and verifies aegis runs
notes: Windows CI runner: msiexec /i target\\wix\\aegis-*.msi /qn. Run aegis --version. Assert exit 0. SCCM/Intune compatibility is implicit from silent install success.

requirement_text: Airgap update bundle with manifest and version file
target_value: Tarball contains binary + SHA-256 manifest + version.json
notes: CI packages: aegis binary + sbom.json + manifest.txt (sha256sum output) + version.json (semver + git SHA + build date). Tarball: aegis-X.Y.Z-airgap-linux-x86_64.tar.gz. No network dependencies at install time.

requirement_text: aegis update --bundle command installs from airgap tarball
target_value: Existing aegis binary can self-update from local tarball
notes: aegis update --bundle <path.tar.gz>. Extracts tarball. Verifies SHA-256 manifest. Verifies GPG signature (if REQ-BUILD-040 done). Replaces current binary atomically via rename.

requirement_text: Cucumber test runner with AegisWorld struct
target_value: cargo test --test cucumber executes scenarios against real ports
notes: New tests/cucumber.rs entry point. AegisWorld holds: TempDir for HOME ledger sessions; Mock or real LlmProvider; Mock or real ChannelApprovalGate; BuiltinExecutor; AgentLoop. Each scenario gets a fresh World. Cucumber reports per-feature results.

requirement_text: ratatui TestBackend event-driven harness for TUI integration tests
target_value: Test can drive App through synthetic key/agent events and assert rendered frame
notes: New aegis-tui integration test. Builds App + TestBackend. Helper: app.send_key(KeyCode) app.send_agent_token(text) app.render() -> Buffer. Snapshots compared via insta. Drives the same App used in production no mocking of layout.

requirement_text: Wiremock LLM provider for deterministic E2E chat tests
target_value: Test starts wiremock with canned SSE responses and aegis chats against it
notes: New helper in aegis-test-support. Spawns wiremock::MockServer. Provides .with_streaming_response(text) and .with_tool_call(call). Returns endpoint URL. aegis-cli config points at it. Used by E2E chat tests.

requirement_text: Tempdir-based test isolation for HOME sessions audit ledger
target_value: Each test gets fresh ~/.aegis tree without polluting real state
notes: IsolatedHome struct: creates tempdir sets AEGIS_HOME env var (or HOME) for test duration. Drops cleanly. Provides .config_path() .sessions_dir() .audit_log_path(). Composable with cucumber World.

requirement_text: LLM cassette recording mode for capturing real provider responses
target_value: AEGIS_RECORD_CASSETTES=1 cargo test records real LLM exchanges to JSON
notes: Extends existing RecordingProvider (REQ-TEST-002) with file format spec. Cassettes at tests/fixtures/cassettes/<test_name>.json. Replay mode is default (deterministic CI). Record mode opt-in via env var. Cassettes are checked in.

requirement_text: First-run user journey E2E test
target_value: From no config to first chat response in single test
notes: Tempdir HOME no config. Spawn wiremock with canned response. Run aegis (no args). Wizard auto-detects wiremock as local provider writes config drops to TUI. Inject prompt via stdin. Assert response visible in rendered frame. Assert audit ledger has session start/stop entries.

requirement_text: Interactive chat E2E with streaming response
target_value: User prompt -> streaming tokens -> finalized assistant message visible in TUI
notes: Uses TUI harness + wiremock. Type prompt press Enter. Receive 10 token events Done event. Assert each token visible in stream_buffer assert final ChatMessage::Assistant in messages. Assert audit ledger records prompt metadata only (no content).

requirement_text: HITL approval E2E (approve path)
target_value: Mutating tool call -> modal -> user presses A -> tool executes -> audit logs HITL_APPROVED
notes: wiremock returns ToolUse(WriteFile). Assert AppPhase::AwaitingApproval. Send KeyCode A. Assert phase ToolExecuting. Assert file actually written to tempdir. Assert audit ledger has HITL_APPROVED entry with tool name and target path.

requirement_text: HITL deny E2E (deny path)
target_value: Mutating tool call -> modal -> user presses D -> tool blocked -> audit logs HITL_DENIED
notes: Same setup as REQ-TEST-027 but press D. Assert file NOT written. Assert audit ledger has HITL_DENIED entry. Assert agent receives denial as tool result and continues loop.

requirement_text: Session save and restore E2E across process restart
target_value: Active conversation survives kill -> restart -> messages and tokens restored
notes: Tempdir HOME wiremock. Run chat send prompt receive response. Send SIGTERM to subprocess. Verify ~/.aegis/sessions/current.json exists. Spawn new aegis subprocess. Assert restored messages match. Assert restored token counts match.

requirement_text: Dev loop iteration E2E (file change -> rebuild -> restart)
target_value: scripts/dev.sh starts both panes file edit triggers rebuild aegis process restarts
notes: Headless tmux session. Stub claude binary. Launch dev.sh. Verify both panes spawned. Touch a .rs file in crates/. Wait for bacon to rebuild. Assert aegis process restarted (new PID). Assert no manual intervention required.

requirement_text: BDD scenario execution coverage report
target_value: CI publishes per-feature pass/fail/wip counts after every cucumber run
notes: Parses cucumber JSON output. Emits markdown table: feature file scenarios passed failed pending wip. Posted as PR comment via gh CLI. Stored as workflow artifact. Used to track BDD adoption progress.

requirement_text: User journey coverage metric
target_value: rtmx reports % of requirements with at least one E2E test
notes: New script reads RTM database test_module column. For each req: classify as unit/integration/e2e based on test path (tests/e2e_*.rs and tests/cucumber.rs => e2e). Report: total reqs reqs with unit reqs with integration reqs with e2e per-category breakdown.

requirement_text: Coverage delta in PR comments
target_value: Every PR shows journey coverage delta vs main
notes: New CI step: compute journey coverage on PR head and base then post difference as PR comment. Format: Before X% After Y% Delta +Z reqs. Highlights requirements that gained or lost test coverage in this PR.

requirement_text: Coverage threshold gate in CI
target_value: CI fails if user journey coverage drops below configured threshold
notes: Configurable in .rtmx/coverage-thresholds.yaml: minimum % of HIGH-priority reqs with E2E tests. Default: ratchet up over time (current % becomes floor). CI step compares current to floor and fails if below. Forces test debt to be addressed.

requirement_text: Ubiquitous language glossary file
target_value: .aegis/glossary.yaml defines bounded context terms
notes: YAML file lists each bounded context (agent hitl audit infra llm tui onboard security) and its core domain terms with definitions. Example: agent.SessionId agent.ToolCall hitl.ApprovalDecision audit.LedgerEntry. Single source of truth for naming.

requirement_text: BDD scenario quality linter
target_value: CI fails if scenarios miss Given/When/Then or use forbidden vocabulary
notes: New linter for .feature files. Rules: every Scenario has Given+When+Then; no implementation details (struct names function names file paths) in Then assertions; vocabulary matches glossary or is whitelisted; @req REQ-XXX-NNN marker present. Runs in CI.

requirement_text: Step definition reuse audit
target_value: CI detects duplicate step definitions across modules
notes: Parses all step definitions in tests/cucumber/steps/. Detects duplicate Given/When/Then patterns across modules (suggests promoting to common_steps.rs). Detects unused steps. Reports as CI annotation.

requirement_text: Test pyramid balance metric
target_value: rtmx reports unit:integration:e2e test ratio with target
notes: Reads test counts from cargo test output. Computes ratio. Emits report against target ratio (e.g. 70:20:10 unit:integration:e2e). Warns when E2E count is too low for production-critical reqs.

requirement_text: CI runs rtmx-update-from-tests on every push
target_value: Status updates from passing tests automatic in CI not just locally
notes: New CI step after tests pass: run scripts/rtmx-update-from-tests.py. If status changes commit them back to the branch with [skip ci] message. PR-only (not on main). Eliminates manual database edits.

requirement_text: BDD-RTM drift detection
target_value: CI fails if scenario @req markers reference non-existent reqs or reqs lack scenarios
notes: Cross-references all @req markers in tests/features/ with .rtmx/database.csv. Failures: marker references unknown REQ-ID; HIGH priority req has zero scenarios; scenario has no @req marker. Posted as CI annotations.

requirement_text: Test failure downgrade automation
target_value: Failing test on a COMPLETE req downgrades it to PARTIAL with reason
notes: Extend rtmx-update-from-tests.py: if a req is COMPLETE but its linked tests now fail mark as PARTIAL with notes field updated to indicate which tests fail. Symmetric with the COMPLETE flip logic. Prevents stale COMPLETE status when code regresses.

requirement_text: Living documentation generator
target_value: BDD scenarios rendered as searchable HTML report from CI
notes: Cucumber output -> HTML report grouped by feature file. Includes scenario text @req links pass/fail status. Published to GitHub Pages on main branch. Becomes the human-readable spec that's always in sync with the code.
